Plot buyer education

How To Know You’re Getting A Good Price 2023

A buyer education piece on comparing similar properties, understanding local demand, and evaluating whether a price is fair.

By Ruchi Realty20 December 20231 min readComments
ShareEmail

This guide explains how buyers can assess whether a property is priced fairly before negotiating or closing a deal.

It recommends comparing similar properties, reviewing listings, and understanding local supply and demand.

The article also suggests considering future development prospects, lender valuation, inspection findings, and repair or improvement costs.
